selection: first unambiguous case in each category, ordered by case ID; no system outputs observed before selection
metrics: actual same-task product resume (conditional on awaiting_input; original total budget)
code_execution: Codex delivery independently reviewed then replayed with no network; no source correction
clarification_release: Pre-written reply copied only after original product run has paused; fresh clarified tasks scored separately.

codex.tool_and_token_budget: native runtime; not equated to product call budget

phase_order: case ID order; incomplete then fresh clarified; product resume then next case
failure_policy: preserve every first result; stop on authentication failure or persistent rate limiting; no selective reruns

isolation.runtime: Bubblewrap mount namespace; parent gold and project trees not mounted

limitations: 5 selected synthetic cases are not representative of real papers
six audited boundary cases excluded before model outputs
not a formal benchmark or superiority claim
